name: Bouncy Castle
desc:
🥭 Welcome to the Biggest Bouncy Castle on Roblox!
🥭 Jump, bounce, play, and slide
🥭 Meet new friends and have tons of fun together
🥭 Collect all the Mangoes hidden around the map for a secret item

👍 Don’t forget to favorite the game and give it a thumbs up if you’re having fun!

⭐ Features:
·   Bouncy Castles: Jump and bounce in our Giant Bouncy Castle!
·   Fun Slides: Experience thrilling slides that will take you on a ride of a lifetime!
·   Creative Play Areas: Engage in exciting play with friends.
·   Mini-Games: Challenge your friends and see who can conquer the mini-games scattered throughout the map!
